contract.instructions:
CONTRACT-ONLY fleshing-out; do not implement.
Source anchors: plan §7.5 row line 2133 (owns TaskGraphDeclarationV1, build-declaration, verify-declaration, parse/canonicalize/validate/seal/expand); §7.6 code-change RED row line 2351 (test declaration_rehashes_plan_and_selected_replay_edges_are_exclusive: expected failure before implementation is that the declaration is invented outside the marked plan region, plan digest mismatches, or H6/H7/H8 require both H3 and H4; minimal passing behavior is that the canonical declaration rehashes the sealed plan and exactly one selected replay predecessor activates); §7.2 lines 1637-1722 (authority and schemas); §5.6 lines 1195-1210 (GateReceiptV1); §8.2 Gate-1 acceptance (graph tests prove oneOf disjunction, reject deadline edges, canonicalize the marked declaration source, bind planSha256, and prove H6/H7/H8 activate exactly one of H3/H4).
Marked declaration region: the uniquely marked region is between <!-- BEGIN RANKING_V3_TASK_GRAPH_DECLARATION_V1 --> (line 1726) and <!-- END RANKING_V3_TASK_GRAPH_DECLARATION_V1 --> (line 1980). Note: the round task packet estimated lines ~1649-1855; the verified marker lines at round_base are 1726-1980 - use the markers, not the estimate.
Prerequisite edge (exact prerequisite table, plan line 1733): R1.T1: R1.0B.
focused_command is a plan-specified future-gate tool test command; its target file scripts/ranking-v3-task-graph.test.mjs does not exist at round_base, so it is unverifiable-at-base. affected_command pnpm test:scripts is repo-verified (package.json line 26).
Required first-RED evidence: implement the test first, confirm it fails at base state (declaration invented outside the marked region or mixed H3/H4 requirements accepted), then implement scripts/ranking-v3-task-graph.mjs until the focused test passes.
The tool validates the declared semantics; it does not invent edges. R1.5 invokes the R1.T1 expansion function while sealing the graph, so concrete E1.<familyId> and E2.<familyId> nodes already exist in TASK_GRAPH.json; no later E-family expansion is needed (§7.2, lines 1644-1647).
